channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Dune: Imperium
item.description: The award-winning board game of strategy and intrigue in the iconic universe of Dune. The Spice must flow.

item.title: Rising World
item.description: Rising World is a voxel based open-world sandbox game, featuring a procedurally generated world, playable in single and multi-player.

item.title: Chest Buster
item.description: An incremental battle game where destroying treasure chests instantly brings item effects into battle to fight enemies. Break all the seals on the Abyss Chest and liberate the great being who will save the world!

item.title: Little Problems: A Cozy Detective Game
item.description: Little Problems is a Cozy Detective game about solving minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems. This game is not about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one case at a time.

item.title: NITRO GEN OMEGA
item.description: A sandbox tactical RPG of steel, fire, friendship, and shonen anime. Assemble your crew, customize your Mech, and lead them in cinematic turn-based battles through a world ruled by rogue AI. The bonds you forge will decide who survives!

item.title: Saturnalia
item.description: A Single-Player Survival Horror Adventure: play as a cast of characters exploring an isolated village haunted by an ancient ritual—but beware, its labyrinthine roads will change each time you lose all your characters.

item.title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante
item.description: A narrative-driven hardcore RPG set in a gritty world ruled by real but unrelenting gods. Set out on a challenging lifetime journey, where every choice has a price and entails consequences. Will you become an inquisitor, a judge, or conspire against the old order? Dare to decide!

item.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu – Lost Explorers' Swords Pack
item.description: Enhance your armory with the Lost Explorers' Swords Pack and unlock two exclusive looks before heading out on expedition.
